bull.b: Coach is demonstrating broad brand momentum across major regions, with particularly strong growth in China and Europe. This geographic performance, combined with higher handbag AURs and footwear growth, supports durable revenue expansion and reinforces Coach as Tapestry’s primary growth engine.

bull.t: Strong margin expansion and cash generation
bull.b: The sharp improvement in operating margin and substantial free cash flow indicate stronger earnings quality and operating leverage. Cash generation gives Tapestry resources to invest in stores, technology and marketing while also funding dividends and repurchases without relying solely on external financing.

Tapestry’s DTC-led model allows greater control over pricing, merchandising, customer relationships and channel economics. Continued growth in owned retail and digital sales can improve data capture and margin quality, while broad channel profitability supports resilience across different distribution environments.

bear.t: Elevated leverage and thin equity cushion
bear.b: The substantially more leveraged capital structure increases Tapestry’s sensitivity to earnings downturns and refinancing conditions. A thinner equity base can amplify shareholder outcomes, while debt obligations may constrain flexibility for investment, acquisitions or additional capital returns if operating performance weakens.

bear.t: Kate Spade revenue and profitability weakness
bear.b: Kate Spade’s expected decline and operating loss create a meaningful drag on consolidated growth and profitability. The brand requires continued investment to restore sustainable top-line momentum, which may absorb marketing and operating resources while Coach carries more of the portfolio’s growth burden.

bear.t: Tariffs create margin and earnings volatility
bear.b: Tariffs introduce an ongoing cost and planning variable that can affect product economics, pricing and the timing of quarterly profits. Although management expects a roughly neutral full-year P&L impact, uneven effects across brands, especially Kate Spade, reduce earnings visibility and could pressure margins.
